title: Spicy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with tender lamb, aromatic spices, and a rich, tangy sauce. This Spicy Algerian Lamb Tagine is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.

ingredients.name: Tangy tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb in batches until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and cook onion, garlic, and ginger until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add browned lamb, tagine spice blend, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Stir in chopped parsley and serve over couscous or rice.
